meta_description:
624 likes, 37 comments - yasminkarachiwala on October 7, 2026: "Here’s a quick upper body workout you can try anytime. 

Just grab a pair of dumbbells and get started. 
Perform each exercise for 12 to 15 reps for 2 to 4 rounds. 

Simple, effective and great for building upper body strength. 

Try it out and let me know in the comments how you liked it... and if you want more workouts like this 💪🏻

Exercises: 

• Drivers
• ⁠Kneeling dumbbell rows
• ⁠Around the world
• ⁠Halo 
• ⁠Kneeling back flye 
• ⁠Curl to serve 

 #upperbodyworkout #shoulders #biceps #functionaltraining #fitnessmotivation".
